title: federation-00: aggregate deliveryState defined three conflicting ways
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md defines the group-chat aggregate deliveryState three ways: L780 (Group Chat Delivery): advances to delivered when all participants have acknowledged; L788 (Delivery State Transitions): 'delivered - All recipients (for group chats: all participants) have acknowledged receipt'; L793: 'delivered when at least one peer has accepted, failed only when ALL peers have permanently failed'. L780/L788 say all, L793 says at least one. Pick one rule and state it once; also define the failed aggregate consistently. Blocks crate-jmap federation outbound deliveryState aggregation (JMAP-v9py.15). Source: crate-jmap spec gap audit 2026-10-19.
notes:
Blocks crate-jmap JMAP-v9py.15.6 (outbound deliveryState aggregation).
DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: for group chats the aggregate deliveryState is the best state any recipient has reached (pending < delivered < received); it is "failed" only when every recipient has permanently failed. Partial failure never downgrades the aggregate; retries to one peer never change other recipients' states. deliveryReceipts stays OPTIONAL ('if supported'). Edit: rewrite federation-00 L780 and the L788-789 bullets to match, keep the L793 paragraph (reworded to the best-state rule). Rationale (Mark): the internet fails in pieces; surface what worked, don't fail when a peer goes down.
close_reason: Fixed in 91672c9 (spec: fix SetError codes, settle open conflicts), pushed.
